import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(1,5,title if False else "48 taxels\n6x8 grid", fontsize=9, bbox=dict(boxstyle="round", fc="white"))
ax.text(4.5,5,"CDC mux\nstatic 25Hz", fontsize=9, bbox=dict(boxstyle="round", fc="white"))
ax.text(1,2.5,"PVDF film\nvibration", fontsize=9, bbox=dict(boxstyle="round", fc="white"))
ax.text(4.5,2.5,"charge amp\n+ 2kHz ADC", fontsize=9, bbox=dict(boxstyle="round", fc="white"))
ax.text(7.5,3.8,"MCU", fontsize=10, bbox=dict(boxstyle="round", fc="white"))
ax.text(7.5,2,"4-wire bus\nPWR GND SDA SCL", fontsize=8, bbox=dict(boxstyle="round", fc="white"))
ax.annotate("", xy=(4.4,5), xytext=(2.8,5), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->"))
ax.annotate("", xy=(4.4,2.5), xytext=(2.8,2.5), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->"))
ax.annotate("", xy=(7.0,4.2), xytext=(5.9,4.8), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->"))
ax.annotate("", xy=(7.0,3.6), xytext=(5.9,2.7), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->"))
ax.annotate("", xy=(7.5,2.6), xytext=(7.5,3.3), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->"))
ax.text(5,0.8,"fixed: rigid core + PCB  wires move with finger", fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("sketch.png")
